fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) manufactures and sells semiconductor products including AI accelerators, microprocessors, GPUs, and FPGAs across three segments: data center, client and gaming, and embedded.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD supplies under brands including Ryzen, EPYC, and Instinct to hyperscale cloud providers, OEMs, and system integrators. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
